# Vendored dependencies

[zfc](zfc/README.md) is the pinned subset of rocq-archive/zfc used by
[the set model](../theories/ZFC_model/README.md). It builds as Rocq library
`ZFC`; its upstream provenance and LGPL license are retained in that folder.

Do not silently replace vendored sources, drop their notices, or treat their
native Ens representation as an internal proof in material BZC. The latter
requires the explicit foundation work documented with the model.
